title: Recidivism
pdf_title: CHAPTER IX RECIDIVISM The information on 'Recidivism' was available in respect of 1411379 offenders out of which 1305296, i.e., 92.5 per cent were new offenders. The percentage of persons who were convicted once, twice and thrice or more was 5.2 per cent, 1.6 per cent and 0.7 per cent, respectively. 11.6 per cent of the persons arrested for the offence of 'Dacosity' had been convicted in the past and this accounted for the highest percentage of recidivism followed by Burglary (9.5 per cent). The relevant statistics in respect of number of offenders and their percentage distribution of 'Recidivism' are presented in Table 53 and 54.
